title: Funksiyani tekshirish va grafik qurish: 20 savol
description: Hosila yordamida funksiyani tekshirish: ekstremumlar, asimptotalar, botiqlik va egilish nuqtalari. Yechimli 20 ta misol — Materiallar bo'limida.

questions.text: y = x⁴ funksiyaning egilish nuqtasi qayerda?
questions.explanation: y″ = 12x² ≥ 0. x = 0 da y″ = 0, lekin ishora almashmaydi, shuning uchun egilish nuqtasi yo'q: grafik hamma joyda botiq.

questions.text: y = ∛x funksiya x = 0 nuqtada nimaga ega?
questions.explanation: y′ = 1/(3∛x²) > 0, funksiya doim o'sadi. y″ ishorasi x = 0 da almashadi (x < 0 botiq, x > 0 qavariq), urinma esa vertikal.

questions.text: y = x³ − 3x² funksiyaning minimum nuqtasi:
y = x³ − x − 1 grafigi Ox o'qini necha marta kesadi?
questions.explanation: Maksimum qiymati y(−1/√3) ≈ −0,615 < 0. Demak, grafik faqat bir marta, x ≈ 1,325 da Ox ni kesadi.

questions.text: y = x(x − 1)³ funksiya uchun x = 1 nuqta:
questions.explanation: y′ = (x − 1)²(4x − 1): x = 1 da y′ = 0, lekin ishora almashmaydi. y″ = 6(x − 1)(2x − 1) esa ishorasini almashtiradi, shuning uchun bu egilish nuqtasi.

questions.text: y = x/(x² + 1) funksiyaning eng katta qiymati:
y = x + 4/x funksiyaning og'ma asimptotasi:
questions.explanation: k = lim y/x = 1, b = lim (y − x) = lim 4/x = 0, demak y = x.

questions.text: y = x²/(x − 1) funksiyaning og'ma asimptotasi:
questions.explanation: Bo'lamiz: x²/(x − 1) = x + 1 + 1/(x − 1). x → ∞ da oxirgi had 0 ga intiladi, demak y = x + 1.

questions.text: y = x/(x² − 1) funksiya o'z sohasining har bir oralig'ida:
questions.explanation: y′ = −(x² + 1)/(x² − 1)² < 0 barcha x ≠ ±1 uchun, shuning uchun ekstremum yo'q.

questions.text: y = x·e⁻ˣ funksiyaning maksimum nuqtasi:
questions.explanation: y′ = e⁻ˣ(1 − x) = 0 ⇒ x = 1; y′ ishorasi + dan − ga o'tadi. y(1) = 1/e ≈ 0,37. (2; 2/e²) esa egilish nuqtasi.

questions.text: y = x³ − 3x funksiya qaysi oraliqda kamayadi?
y = x⁴ − 2x² funksiyaning egilish nuqtalari abssissalari:
y = (x − 1)²(x + 2) grafigi x = 1 nuqtada Ox o'qiga nisbatan:
questions.explanation: x = 1 ikki karrali ildiz: y ≥ 0 uning atrofida, y(1) = 0 — minimum (1; 0). Grafik Ox ga urinadi.

questions.text: y = x/(x − 2) funksiyaning gorizontal asimptotasi:
questions.explanation: y = 1 + 2/(x − 2) → 1, x → ±∞ da. x = 2 esa vertikal asimptota.

questions.text: y = 1/(x² − 4) funksiya uchun x = 0 nuqta:
questions.explanation: y′ = −2x/(x² − 4)²: x < 0 da musbat, x > 0 da manfiy. Demak, x = 0 da lokal maksimum, garchi qiymati manfiy bo'lsa ham: y(0) = −1/4.

questions.text: y = x³/(x² − 1) funksiyaning minimum nuqtasi:
questions.explanation: y′ = x²(x² − 3)/(x² − 1)² = 0 ⇒ x = 0, ±√3. x = √3 da y′ ishorasi − dan + ga o'tadi: y = 3√3/2 ≈ 2,6. x = 0 — ekstremum emas.

questions.text: y = x²·e⁻ˣ funksiyaning maksimum qiymati:
y = ln(x² + 1) funksiya qaysi oraliqda botiq (y″ > 0)?
questions.explanation: y″ = 2(1 − x²)/(x² + 1)² > 0 ⇔ |x| < 1. Egilish nuqtalari (±1; ln 2).

questions.text: y = x·ln x funksiyaning minimum nuqtasi:
questions.explanation: y′ = ln x + 1 = 0 ⇒ x = 1/e; y = −1/e ≈ −0,37. (1; 0) — Ox bilan kesishish, x = 0 esa sohaga kirmaydi.
